{{Top|sprot}}
{{Image}}
{{Quote|This is the purpose of life, is it not? To create life is the greatest act a living creature can commit.|[[Ooryl Qrygg]]|<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Narglatchpreggo-woswfg.jpg|thumb|right|300px|[[Narglatch/Legends|Narglatch]] females always give birth to twins, one male and one female]]
'''Reproduction''' was the biological or artificial process in which new organisms were produced from one or more [[Parent/Legends|parent]] organisms. '''Sex''' was an activity that could result in procreation. Individuals from different genetically compatible [[Species/Legends|species]] could potentially conceive a [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]].

==Sexual reproduction==
{{Quote|If having kids is so important, why don't you have any?''"<br />"''I am ''januwine''. It is not for me to choose a wife, but for Gand to choose one for me. At that time I shall proudly commit genetic fusion.''"<br />"''The idea loses something in translation there.|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Ooryl Qrygg]]|<ref name="I, Jedi" />}}
Many [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] produced new [[Youngling/Legends|offspring]] through sexual reproduction,<ref name="Galaxy Guide 12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> the mating of [[Parent/Legends|parent]] organisms with compatible genetic material.<ref name="Isard's Revenge">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref> Other methods of combining [[sperm]] with an [[ovum]] could also produce a new life form.<ref name="DFJK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref> In most [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]], the offspring would then gestate in the mother's [[Womb/Legends|womb]] until birth.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Some species were capable of producing [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]] offspring with other species, such as [[Human/Legends|Human]]-[[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]<ref name="Nightsisters">{{InsiderCite|122|Everything You Always Wanted to Know about the Nightsisters but Were Afraid to Ask}}</ref> or [[Borneck]]-[[Etti]] pairings.<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref>

In terms of evolutionary habits, species that could only reproduce a few offspring at a time tended to devote more resources to the nurturing and protection of said offspring than in comparison to those who could produce many offspring. In the latter type, it was common for many offspring to [[Death/Legends|die]] soon after birth, but enough individuals typically survived to maintain the population. Various species and organisms reproduced at various seasons continuously throughout their lives. These intervals could usually be mapped into cycles known as ''reproduction cycles''. In contrast, other organisms could only reproduce once in their lifetime, often dying shortly after reproduction either due to the actions of their mate or due to genetic influence.<ref name="The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide" />

Some individuals, such as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], believed that sexual intercourse between those not married was immoral.<ref name="Last One Standing">{{StoryCite|story=The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>

==Asexual reproduction==
{{Quote|My people reproduce as they will, and I decided it was time for me to do so.|[[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron]], a Hutt, comments on her pregnancy|<ref name="THG">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref>}}
Asexual forms of reproduction involved individual organisms producing new organisms through non-sexual methods. For instance, [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] utilized fission.<ref name="The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> The [[Ergesh]] had a ritual where two individuals each produced a [[Seed/Legends|seed]] containing their own genetic code, then planted them together in a swamp called the ''[[Shoolbloorp]]'', the "Land of Beginnings."<ref name="Alien Encounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>

Some species that were hermaphroditic, such as most [[Gastropod/Legends|gastropods]] and [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-based species, were capable of self-fertilization. [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] could reproduce by themselves<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> or mate with another Hutt.<ref name="Murder Most Foul">''[[Boba Fett: Murder Most Foul]]''</ref>

The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] did not engage in any reproductive activities, yet somehow became pregnant with her son, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] theorized that it was the result of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] using the [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] found in all living beings to conceive a prophesied [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]].<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref> When [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] met Anakin Skywalker and felt his strength in the Force, he suspected it to be the result of his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] master, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], working with Sidious to tip the [[Balance/Legends|balance]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] towards the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

===Cloning===
{{Main|Cloning/Legends}}
{{Quote|You are a clone. That means you are my son. Period. No one else, no woman was involved.|[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], to his son, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]]|<ref name="Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive">''[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive]]''</ref>}}
Cloning referred to the process of reproducing a near symmetrical duplicate of a being through artificial means. By obtaining the genetic code of an individual, numerous copies of said individual could be created.<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> Various species, such as the [[Khommite/Legends|Khommites]], [[Columi/Legends|Columi]]<ref name="CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:7:01 Edition">{{InsiderCite|68|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:7:01 Edition}}</ref> and [[Verpine/Legends|Verpines]] relied on cloning as their chief means of reproduction.<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> The [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] used the art of the cloning as a production resource, notably selling clones of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to create an [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|army]].<ref name="Episode II" />

==Non-reproductive sexual activities==
{{Quote|Well, the parts line up fine as far as I'm concerned, but things don't connect that well on a cellular level, I guess.|Human male Gavin Darklighter, on his incompatibility with Bothan female Asyr Sei'lar|<ref name="Isard's Revenge" />}}
[[File:Xesh_and_Shae_spend_the_night.jpg|thumb|left|300px|[[Shae Koda]] and [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] spend the night together.]]
Many [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings engaged in sexual intercourse for reasons other than reproduction, such as for recreational purposes or as a means to express their romantic love and care for one another.<ref name="Force War 2">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 2]]</ref> It occurred between beings of differing [[Gender/Legends|genders]] or of the same gender, often feeling attraction towards one specific gender or to multiple genders.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>

The [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltrons]], a pink-skinned species from the planet [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]], were known for having many transient sexual relationships on a casual basis. Although their promiscuity often confused and embarrassed other species, including Humans, the Zeltrons were not ashamed of that cultural trait. On the contrary, they regarded [[Marriage/Legends|monogamy]] as an eccentric practice.<ref name="SWG1">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref> The non-Zeltrons often met their overt sexual advances with great disconcertion.<ref name="SW70">[[Star Wars (1977) 70|''Star Wars'' (1977) 70]]</ref>

[[Prostitute/Legends|Some beings]] exchanged sexual relations for [[Currency/Legends|payment]].<ref name="BFT1">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 9|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 9]]</ref> Their work could be confined within [[Brothel/Legends|brothels]],<ref name="PST">{{StoryCite|story=Soup's On: The Pipe Smoker's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> which were often associated with other venues like [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] dens.<ref name="THG" /> Other workers, however, would converse with potential customers outdoors.<ref name="FT1">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 26|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 26]]</ref> The Zeltron [[cafarel]] were known for fulfilling any carnal desire a being might have.<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

Jedi of the [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] were not celibate and were allowed to have sex, but they were not allowed to form attachments.<ref name="Prisoners">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Although the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] established that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] members could not marry or have children, ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] explained that despite their monastic culture, the Jedi were permitted to have sexual intercourse as long they did not form attachments.<ref name="Jedi Sex Life">{{WebCite|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/entertainment/1989505.stm|text=George Lucas: 'I'm still 25'|date=2002-05-15|quote=But Lucas revealed that despite their monastic regime, Jedi were permitted to have sex. "Jedi Knights aren't celibate - the thing that is forbidden is attachments - and possessive relationships."|work=[[Wikipedia:BBC News|BBC News]]|archivedate=20021018032135}}</ref> This is also stated in the [[2009]] novel ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''.<ref name="Prisoners" />
